derivative_provenance.relationship: JSON values identical to the source protocol except retained local paths replaced by PUBLIC aliases; wrapper records this derivative identity.

allowed_later_reads: PUBLIC:freeze/freeze.complete.json and its listed frozen payloads for identity verification
complete-result.json fields needed for status, camera correction, refinement, audit and held-out summaries
only referenced frozen camera and held-out-summary arrays
only referenced observer held-out RMS and prediction arrays, with producer receipt identity checks
the exact pinned original calibration_heldout.npy, only after a frozen camera and observer prediction are available
Matplotlib runtime/font files required for rendering and their identities

execution.controls: unchanged; render only retained results and declared presentation reductions
execution.overwrite_retry_cleanup: none; retain all partial output and write failure provenance where possible

figure_1.audit_pairing: pair result/observer audit rows only at identical ordinal with identical case_id; retain every unpaired observer row separately
figure_1.claims: descriptive finite-procedure record; no convergence, recovery, global-identification or confidence claim
figure_1.missing_values: literal unavailable/nonfinite/outcome labels; never substitute zero or infer a missing outcome
figure_1.objective_definition: Q128 half mean-squared training residual: (central squared residual sum + all 27 structured squared residual sums)/(2*M), M=28*Nz*Ny*Nx
figure_1.objective_scale: linear; include every finite reported objective and zero; no logarithms, clipping, smoothing or fitted trend
panels: all serialized refinement trace entries: every finite reported objective as a marker, with missing/nonfinite outcomes retained in the outcome strip
incumbent minimum over finite initial summary objective plus finite trace objectives in original serialized order; no interpolated or extrapolated evaluations
one outcome-strip marker per trace entry, including infeasible, incomplete, missing and other literal outcome strings
all 3 by 5 held-out RMS entries for each of returned handoff and selected-candidate replay, without value-dependent source selection
every audit record in original order, including reported outcome, calibration/operator max-absolute deltas, equivalence/material flags, reason and failure code
every observer audit comparison, including status, max/l2/rms/count, discrepancy and material flag, or its literal unavailable/incomplete reason
figure_1.refinement_x_axis: serialized trace ordinal; major ticks use deterministic stride ceil(trace_count/12), include first and last, and label ordinal plus reported evaluation_index on both trace rows; thinning is explicitly labeled and affects ticks only; every objective/outcome remains plotted and every record remains in scope JSON; initial summary is a distinct anchor, not a new evaluation
figure_1.rms_display: all 15 cells for both sources; six significant digits in figure and unchanged full stored numbers in scope JSON; no averaging across exposures

figure_2.all_zero_scale: only when the corresponding maximum absolute value equals zero, display +/-1 reference-flat-relative unit and label the artificial display extent explicitly
figure_2.aspect_interpolation: equal physical aspect, origin lower, nearest, no crop or resampling
figure_2.coordinates: global micrometres; calibration origin is lower detector corner; sample centers origin+(index+1/2)*spacing; pixel-edge extents use origin through origin+N*spacing

original_observation.access: post-freeze presentation only; verify hash before load and full identity after read; inspect/use only frame [0,0]
original_observation.correction: (raw held-out frame - frozen camera.means_counts[1])/frozen camera.contrast_counts, exactly once; no camera refit

figure_2.prediction: run.json bead_replay.predictions.heldout array at [0,0], already evaluated from the frozen selected candidate; no optical calls or fitting
figure_2.projection_residual_rule: difference of the displayed prediction and observation maximum projections; never maximum projection of the voxelwise residual
figure_2.residual_scale: one separate linear symmetric reference-flat-relative scale for all four displayed residual panels: +/- maximum absolute displayed residual value
rows: full XY maximum projection over z
full XZ maximum projection over y
figure_2.signal_scale: one linear symmetric signed reference-flat-relative scale for all eight displayed signal panels: +/- maximum absolute displayed signal value; no clipping or normalization
figure_2.status_label: always show actual handoff/run/replay status; an unavailable handoff with a retained selected candidate is labeled selected-candidate replay after unavailable handoff
figure_2.unavailable: if required frozen camera, replay prediction or pinned observation is absent, emit a text-only figure stating the exact gap; never invent signal panels

limits: No original data values are read during preparation.
No truth, seeds, plans, other original observations or product implementation are read by the renderer.
Display reductions and the declared affine camera correction are presentation only; no new inference or data fitting.
A successful rendering is not scientific success or a product verification verdict.
Replay shares finite optical physics and is not an independent physical reference.
No convergence, recovery, global-identification, confidence or empirical-optics claim.
record: exact command, UTC times, interpreter/platform and actual package versions
SHA256 and byte size of all read scientific/preparation inputs, renderer/protocol/notes and used font files
producer run and freeze status, frozen candidate presence, all plotted statuses/outcomes and unchanged full numerical scope
fixed selection, units, coordinate extents, section coordinates, signed scales and projection residual rule
all input identities before/after, script/protocol identity before/after, and PNG/SVG/scope hashes
all gaps, failures, unsupported claims and arithmetic/shared-physics limits

protocol.status: coordinator-authorized display-only correction after render 3 legibility inspection; one render 4 execution
